messages:
anya: Hey @eng - noticed per-project quota tiles showing >100% utilization for proj-42 even though project's logs show only ~40k tokens. Dashboard seems to count shared org requests twice when project belongs to an org with a shared pool. Anyone else seeing double-counting?
leo: can you paste a screenshot or the tile id? Also which window? rolling-1h or rolling-24h?
anya: tile id: tile_7d2a, window=rolling-1h. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/abc123. Also reproducer: when I trigger a bulk embed job (org token), proj-42 and proj-43 both spike same token amount.
maria (support): we've had similar reports but assumed it's aggregation lag. Can you share sample request IDs and timestamps?
anya: sure, sample logs:
```
2026-02-27T15:02:11Z req_id=abc123 project=proj-42 org=org-7 tokens=120 route=/v1/embed
2026-02-27T15:02:11Z req_id=abc123 project=proj-43 org=org-7 tokens=120 route=/v1/embed
```
looks like the same backend job fans out and gets attributed to multiple projects? not sure.
leo: that log looks like fan-out based on branch. Our meter should attribute tokens to the originating project only. tagging bug?
sre-bot: rate-limit:org org-7 exceeded rolling-1h quota at 2026-02-27T15:03:00Z (enforced)
ryan (billing): if dashboard double-counts, invoices could over-report per-project units. Do we have any invoices flagged by customers?
maria (support): one customer ticket from acme-corp reported project quotas hitting limits but invoice looked normal. I'll link ticket #SUP-824.
leo: quick hypothesis: when a worker fan-out clones the request, meters are incremented per child with no dedupe on org-level id. Need to check meter keying. Can someone dump the metering code path for fanout?
anya: repro steps I used:
1) create two projects under same org
2) run single embed call that fans out internally to both projects
3) observe dashboard per-project tiles and api logs
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -d '{"input": ["..."], "project": "proj-42" }' -H 'Authorization: Bearer X'
leo: thanks. I'll add logging around meter->increment with keys: project_id, org_id, request_fanout_parent_id.
maria: adding to internal ticket. marking P1 until we confirm no invoice impact. @ryan can you check last billing cycle for org-7? any anomalies?
ryan (billing): scanning... no invoice anomalies so far but will audit token-ledgers for org-7 between 2026-02-20 and 2026-02-28. will update by EOD.
leo: quick patch idea: dedupe by parent_request_id at org aggregation layer. filing PR.
leo: PR #4529 opened, adding unit test to simulate fanout dedupe.
maria: thanks. I'll set customer expectation: we're investigating root cause, temporary workaround is to pin project to dedicated capacity or disable fanout.
anya: appreciated. keep us posted :thumbsup:
ryan (billing): found ledger entries showing per-project double increment for 2026-02-27 15:02-15:05 window for org-7. I'll correlate with meter service logs.
leo: found bug in meter service: child requests lacked parent_request_id header when forwarded, causing double count. patch landed in canary.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary roll 2026-03-01T09:12 succeeded for meter-service v1.3.1-canary
maria: closing loop with customer, will confirm quota tiles stabilize after next roll.
anya: confirmed after canary, tiles look correct now for 1h window. thanks team!
